name: deBridge
description: deBridge is a cross-chain interoperability and liquidity transfer protocol that allows the decentralized transfer of arbitrary data and assets between various blockchains

methodology.Fees: All fees paid by users for swap and bridge tokens via deBridge.
methodology.Revenue: Fees are distributed to deBridge protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fee goes to protocol treasury from 20th june 2025.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Protocol revenue is used for buyback(started from 20th june 2025).
